text:
alex_k: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 503s and long tails from hosted inference in eu-west-2 since ~09:02 UTC. Seeing a restart spike on upstream workers.

oncall-bot: Alert: hosted-infer-eu-west-2 5xx rate > 10% (svc/hosted-infer) 09:03:12 -> 09:20:00. AlertID: A-2026-9987

sre_hiro: I can see a bunch of pod restarts on pool-eu2-hotmodel. Pods on node gpu-eu2-07 showing SIGABRT and OOMKill. Pulling logs now.

eng_tom: logs show cuda allocation failure during kv prefetch on hotmodel runner: 

```nE 09:03:08 infer_runner.cpp:412 cuda_malloc failed: out of memory (c10::CudaMemoryError)
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'c10::Error'
Aborted (core dumped)
```

eng_zoe: reproducer in staging: start a 50k-token request then trigger a model hot-swap on the same worker, prefetched kv still loading -> GPU memory spike -> OOM in ~10-18s.

alex_k: customer impact: Acme & BetaApp seeing 503s and toolcalls timing out. CS opened tickets, asking for ETA and root cause.

cs_lynn: please provide a short customer-safe blurb for Acme (they asked for a timeline).

alex_k: suggested blurb: "We're investigating an infrastructure issue where upstream inference workers in eu-west-2 are restarting during large-context requests. We've routed traffic away from affected workers and are deploying mitigations. We'll update within 30 minutes."

ops_maya: immediate mitigations applied: cordoned gpu-eu2-07 node, scaled down hotmodel pool in eu-west-2, adjusted routing to favor pool-eu2-cold. Rolling restarts kicked off with PREFETCH_ENABLED=false.

eng_tom: pushed a short-term fix: gate model swap if active_kv_bytes > 200MB and reduce default kv cache to 128MB for hotmodel group. Rolling restart in progress (4 pods).

support-bot: Observed error rate drop: 5xx in eu-west-2 reduced from 12.4% -> 1.5% after draining and restart (09:18 UTC). Alert cleared at 09:21:40.

eng_zoe: repro steps I used in staging:
1) send streaming request with long prompt (~45k tokens)
2) while prefetch in progress, trigger orchestrator hot-swap to load a new quantized image
3) observe c10::cudaMalloc failure in runner logs
logs:

```n[staging] req=stg-9 start prefetch
[staging] swap_start -> load weights quant-v2
[staging] c10::cudaMalloc(ptr, 2199023255552) -> OOM
```

sre_hiro: nodes show NVML reset events and kernel messages about GPU page faults. Temporarily tainted affected nodes and disabled hotswap orchestration on hotmodel pool.

eng_tom: created PR to add a fallback path to stream weight load on CPU if GPU mem insufficient and to add pre-swap KV size checks: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/5409

ops_maya: routing note: smart-routing masked the impact for most customers, but ACME had pinned routes to hotmodel pool which caused their requests to hit failing workers. We pushed a temporary dynamic-unpin for pinned routes.

cs_lynn: sent customer update to ACME & BetaApp with mitigation steps and ETA for canary test (1hr). They asked to be on the postmortem.

eng_zoe: follow-up action items: add early OOM telemetry (per-pod active_gpu_bytes), prevent concurrent prefetch+hotswap by lock, add integration test that attempts hotswap under active prefetch.

alex_k: incident ticket RD-INC-2026-99 created, postmortem owners: eng_tom (root cause), sre_hiro (operational), cs_lynn (customer comms). Scheduling postmortem in 48h.

oncall-bot: Note: rolling canary scheduled at 10:30 UTC — will only re-enable hot-swap after successful canary.

support-bot: closing note: error rate stable at 0.9% p95 latency back to baseline after reroute. Keeping pool drained for one hour for monitoring.

alex_k: thanks all, will update channel if anything changes.
